issues.description: Directory path from user input is passed to filepath.WalkDir without proper validation. No verification that the resolved absolute path is within expected boundaries.
issues.recommendation: Use filepath.Join and filepath.Rel to verify the resolved absolute path stays within the intended directory.

issues.description: User-supplied JSON from batch file is unmarshalled directly without schema validation or size limits, potentially allowing large allocations.
issues.recommendation: Implement size limits on JSON input (use io.LimitReader), validate field types explicitly.

issues.description: os.Rename operation is not atomic at application level. Between checking file existence and performing rename, another process could create the file.
issues.recommendation: Use atomic file operations; write to temp file, then use os.Rename which is atomic on most filesystems.

issues.description: Large JSON database files are unmarshalled without size validation. This could cause memory exhaustion if attacker controls the data.json file.
issues.recommendation: Implement size limits on file reads. For large files, use json.Decoder with streaming approach.

issues.description: Temporary files created with predictable pattern 'dataFile + .tmp'. If multiple processes write simultaneously, collisions could occur.
issues.recommendation: Use os.CreateTemp to generate cryptographically random temp filenames.

issues.description: Write to tmp file + os.Rename sequence has a potential race window where data loss could occur if process crashes between operations.
issues.recommendation: Implement file locking (fcntl/flock) around the entire write-rename sequence.

issues.description: Journal entries are unmarshalled line-by-line without size validation. Malicious journal entries could cause memory exhaustion.
issues.recommendation: Add maximum line length validation before json.Unmarshal. Use bufio.Scanner.Buffer() to limit line sizes.

issues.description: Check if destination exists then perform operations. Between check and operation, destination could be created/modified by another process, causing overwrite of unintended file.
issues.issue_type: TOCTOU Race Condition - File Overwrite Risk
issues.recommendation: Use atomic file operations with O_EXCL flag or file locking. Avoid separate stat/rename calls.

issues.description: os.RemoveAll(src) is called after batch operations. If some files failed but result shows success, RemoveAll could delete files that were skipped or failed.
issues.issue_type: Unsafe Batch File Deletion - Data Loss Risk
issues.recommendation: Only delete source if ALL files successfully moved. Track which files actually moved to prevent deleting unprocessed files.

issues.description: If copyFile succeeds but os.Remove(src) fails, file is duplicated but error is returned. Caller does not know source still exists, potentially causing data duplication.
issues.recommendation: Implement transaction-style rollback: if Remove fails, remove the copied dst and return error.

issues.description: filepath.Walk traverses user-supplied path without validation. Symlinks in the source directory could lead to operations outside intended scope.
issues.recommendation: Before walking, resolve source path to absolute and verify it does not contain symlinks to parent directories.

issues.description: Temporary file name uses time.Now().UnixNano() for uniqueness, but in high-concurrency scenarios two processes could generate identical timestamps.
issues.recommendation: Use os.CreateTemp instead of manual naming. It uses cryptographically secure randomness.

issues.description: root.Open(name) returns a file handle but the file is never closed in OpenRead function. Caller must close it, but if caller forgets, file descriptor leaks.
issues.recommendation: Document that caller must close the returned file. Consider returning only data (bytes) rather than file handles.

issues.description: Studios.json is unmarshalled without size validation. Malicious JSON could cause memory exhaustion.
issues.recommendation: Add file size limits before reading. Use json.Decoder with streaming for large files.

issues.description: Regex patterns could match very long strings, potentially causing Regex Denial of Service in edge cases.
issues.recommendation: Add string length limits before regex matching. Test regexes with very long inputs.
